versions.changelog:
Initial release of YunZhi SEO Audit & Optimization Pipeline skill:

- Implements a full website SEO health check, optimization, and scoring pipeline with per-dimension analysis (keywords, Title, Description, Heading, URL, internal links, Schema, indexability, and more).
- Provides a zero-dependency Python script for crawling and analysis; outputs structured reports and risk-graded suggestions.
- Supports both generic websites (online audit) and CMS sites (offline analysis via MCP), including precise instructions and data safety constraints.
- Includes thorough workflow documentation, risk classification, scoring model, and CMS field mapping in newly added reference files.
- Switches from shell scripts to Python for all core logic, removing legacy scripts and npm configs.
